title: Morning Village Greeting & Inquiring about Health
setting: Village path in Powaimukh in the early morning
cultural_notes: Traditional polite Tai greeting inquires about where one is going ('pai1 theu1?') or if one has eaten rice ('kin1 khaw3 yow3 haa1?').

turns.speaker: SPK1
turns.khamyang_roman: maɯ2 pai1 theu1 wan1 nai6 nang1?
turns.assamese_script: মাই² পাই¹ থ্যউ¹ ৱান¹ নাই⁶ নাং¹?
turns.translation_en: Where are you going this morning, lady?

turns.speaker: SPK2
turns.khamyang_roman: khaa1 te5 pai1 vi1 haan1, ao1 khaw3 sang3 thawaai3 phraa4.
turns.lik_tai: ၶႃႈတေပႆဝိႁၢၼ်ႇ၊ ဢဝ်ၶဝ်ႈသၢင်ႉထဝၢႆးၽြႃး
turns.assamese_script: খা³ তে⁵ পাই¹ ৱি¹ হান¹, আও¹ খাও³ সাং³ থাৱাই³ ফ্ৰা⁴।
turns.gloss: 1SG.POL IRR go monastery, take rice alms offer Buddha
turns.translation_en: I am going to the monastery to offer morning alms to the Buddha.
turns.translation_as: মই বৌদ্ধ বিহাৰলৈ গৈছোঁ, ভগৱান বুদ্ধলৈ পুৱাৰ ভোজন আগবঢ়াবলৈ।

turns.speaker: SPK1
turns.khamyang_roman: po5 me5 maɯ2 yu5 li1 kin1 waan1 yu5 haa1?
turns.assamese_script: পৌ⁵ মে⁵ মাই² য়ু⁵ লী¹ কিন¹ ৱান¹ য়ু⁵ হা¹?
turns.gloss: father mother 2SG live good eat sweet CONT Q
turns.translation_en: Are your parents keeping well and in good health?

turns.speaker: SPK2
turns.khamyang_roman: khao5 yu5 di1 li1 chaw1. maɯ2 kin1 khaw3 yow3 haa1?
turns.lik_tai: ၶဝ်ယူႇလီလီၸဝ်ႈ။ မႂ်ႇၵိၼ်ၶဝ်ႈယဝ်ႉႁႃ
turns.assamese_script: খাও⁵ য়ু⁵ দী¹ লী¹ চাও¹। মাই² কিন¹ খাও³ য়ও³ হা¹?
turns.gloss: 3PL live well good lord. 2SG eat rice COMPL Q
turns.translation_en: They are very well, sir. Have you eaten your morning meal yet?
turns.translation_as: তেওঁলোক বৰ কুশলে আছে। আপুনি পুৱাৰ ভাত খালে নে?

turns.speaker: SPK1
turns.khamyang_roman: kin1 yow3 chaw1. pai1 li1 li1 nɔ!
turns.lik_tai: ၵိၼ်ယဝ်ႉၸဝ်ႈ။ ပႆလီလီၼေႃႈ
turns.assamese_script: কিন¹ য়ও³ চাও¹। পাই¹ লী¹ লী¹ নৌ!
turns.gloss: eat COMPL lord. go good good EMPH
turns.translation_en: Yes, I have eaten. Go safely on your way!

title: Paddy Field Farming & Monsoon Cultivation Conversation
setting: Edge of the rice paddy (naa1) in Powaimukh
cultural_notes: Agricultural mutual aid and water discussions are the foundation of Tai village cohesion.

turns.speaker: SPK1
turns.khamyang_roman: nam6 tem1 nai1 naa1 yow3 haa1 nɔŋ4 chaai1?
turns.lik_tai: ၼမ်ႉတဵမ်ၼႂ်းၼႃးယဝ်ႉႁႃၼွင်ႉၸၢႆး
turns.assamese_script: নাম⁶ তেম¹ নাই¹ না¹ য়ও³ হা¹ নং⁴ চাই¹?
turns.gloss: water full inside paddy COMPL Q younger-brother
turns.translation_en: Has the rain water filled the paddy field yet, younger brother?

turns.speaker: SPK2
turns.khamyang_roman: nam6 jin1 khɯn3 maa1 tem1 thung2 yow3 lung1.
turns.lik_tai: ၼမ်ႉၵျိၼ်းၶိုၼ်ႈမႃးတဵမ်ထုင်ႉယဝ်ႉလုင်
turns.assamese_script: নাম⁶ জিন¹ খ্যুন³ মা¹ তেম¹ থুং² য়ও³ লুং¹।
turns.gloss: water Dihing rise come full field COMPL uncle
turns.translation_en: The Dihing river has risen and flooded the entire plain, uncle.
turns.translation_as: দিহিং নদীৰ পানী বাঢ়ি সমগ্ৰ পথাৰ ওপঙি পৰিছে, বৰদেউতা।

turns.speaker: SPK1
turns.khamyang_roman: mua4 nai6 haw1 te5 dam1 khaw3 niew1 phɔm6 kan1.
turns.lik_tai: မိူဝ်ႈၼႆႉႁဝ်းတေလမ်ၶဝ်ႈၼဵဝ်ၽွမ်ႉၵၼ်
turns.assamese_script: ম্যুৱা⁴ নাই⁶ হাও¹ তে⁵ দাম¹ খাও³ নিৱ¹ ফম্⁶ কান¹।
turns.gloss: time this 1PL IRR transplant rice sticky together RECIP
turns.translation_en: At this time we shall transplant the sticky rice together.
turns.translation_as: এতিয়া আমি মিলি বৰা ধানৰ কঠিয়া ৰুম।

turns.speaker: SPK2
turns.khamyang_roman: li1 yow3! haw1 khao5 te5 ao1 kwaai1 maa1 thai3 din1.
turns.lik_tai: လီယဝ်ႉ။ ႁဝ်းၶဝ်တေဢဝ်ၵႂၢႆးမႃးထႆလိၼ်
turns.assamese_script: লী¹ য়ও³! হাও¹ খাও⁵ তে⁵ আও¹ ক্বাই¹ মা¹ থাই³ দিন¹।
turns.gloss: good COMPL! 1PL 3PL IRR bring buffalo come plow soil
turns.translation_en: Very good! We will bring our water buffaloes to plow the soil.
turns.translation_as: বৰ ভাল! আমি ম'হবোৰ লৈ মাটি চহাবলৈ আহিম।
